content.text:
Yes, in this snapshot `functools` exposes `Placeholder`, which is used to leave positional slots open in a `partial`.

`library/functools.rst` documents `Placeholder` as a sentinel. When a `partial` object is called, any `Placeholder` sentinels in it are filled in with the new positional arguments. A placeholder can also be kept open by inserting a new `Placeholder` where the old one was. The documentation's example imports it with `from functools import partial, Placeholder as ...`.

I relied on the search snippet and did not read the full section.
